phase_title: integrated_decision 最終実測GO/NO-GO判定レポート設計
phase_purpose: Phase 15 最終実測確定判定層：integrated_decision を最終実測データから GO/NO-GO 判定するレポート構造を設計する
execution_context: reports-only design phase; no actual measurement data entry or confirmation yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. No app/tests implementation permitted until integrated_decision=GO and receiver_validator_implementation_permission=EFFECTIVE are both confirmed via actual human review data.
governance.hard_stop_condition: integrated_decision must remain NO_GO in all template fields until actual measurement confirms otherwise

report_structure.report_timing: Upon completion of Phase 14 (all final decision layers) and Phase 15-1 through 15-6 (all input reinforcement)
report_structure.decision_subject: integrated_decision final actual measurement GO/NO-GO determination

measurement_timestamp.requirement: Timestamp of final actual measurement decision

evidence_lock_status.requirement: All evidence from Phase 14-8 (final effective feasibility assessment) must be confirmed as locked
evidence_lock_status.confirmation_rule: Must be true before GO determination possible

stop_conditions_triggered.requirement: Phase 12-6 (immediate stop conditions) must not have any triggered stop
stop_conditions_triggered.confirmation_rule: Must be false before GO determination possible

criteria_list.description: All evidence indices must be locked
No immediate stop conditions from Phase 12-6 can be active
receiver_validator_implementation_permission must be ready for effective evaluation
criteria_list.confirmation_source: Phase 15-8 receiver validator final measurement report

criteria_list.description: production_status must remain NO_GO during all measurement phases
criteria_list.confirmation_source: Hardcoded safety constant across all phases

criteria_list.description: No Phase 11-4 (defect escalation detection) issues remain unresolved

integrated_decision_actual_measurement_r.template_rule: In design phase, all template instances must show NO_GO. Actual GO determination waits for confirmed human review data entry.
integrated_decision_actual_measurement_r.go_determination_rule: GO only when ALL 5 criteria above are met AND measurement timestamp recorded AND human review has entered concrete data into Phase 15-1 (integrated_decision input) and Phase 15-2 (receiver validator input)
integrated_decision_actual_measurement_r.no_go_maintenance_rule: NO_GO is default. Maintain NO_GO if any criterion fails or if Phase 14-6 (GO stop conditions) triggered

confidence_assessment.template_rule: In design phase, all instances show UNCONFIRMED. Actual levels depend on completeness of human review data.

recommendation_for_next_phase.template_rule: In design phase, default to HALT. Actual recommendation depends on integrated_decision_final_actual_status and receiver_validator_permission outcome

primary_sources: Phase 15-1 integrated_decision final actual measurement input (human review entry)
Phase 15-2 receiver_validator_implementation_permission final actual measurement input (human review entry)
Phase 14 final decision layer evidence and feasibility assessments
Phase 12-6 immediate stop conditions monitoring logs

step_1_evidence_lock_verification.condition: All evidence indices must be confirmed locked
step_1_evidence_lock_verification.halt_condition: If any evidence remains unlocked, HALT and return to Phase 15-5

step_2_stop_conditions_check.action: Check Phase 12-6 for active stop conditions
step_2_stop_conditions_check.condition: No immediate stops can be active
step_2_stop_conditions_check.halt_condition: If stops are active, HALT and return to Phase 12-6

step_3_criteria_validation.halt_condition: If any criterion is FALSE, set integrated_decision_final_actual_status = NO_GO and HALT

step_4_human_review_data_confirmation.action: Confirm Phase 15-1 and 15-2 human review data entry is complete
step_4_human_review_data_confirmation.condition: Both input formats must have concrete, non-template data
step_4_human_review_data_confirmation.halt_condition: If data is missing or still template-only, HALT and request human review input

step_5_final_decision_determination.logic: IF all criteria TRUE AND no stops AND evidence locked AND human data complete THEN integrated_decision = GO; ELSE integrated_decision = NO_GO

depends_on: Phase 15-1: integrated_decision final actual measurement input format
Phase 15-2: receiver_validator_implementation_permission final actual measurement input format
feeds_into: Phase 15-8: receiver validator permission final measurement (decision result as input)
Phase 15-9: Phase 15 completion declaration (decision result as component)

design_review_checklist: Report structure captures all 5 GO determination criteria
Evidence lock verification is mandatory before decision
Stop conditions check prevents false GO determination
Human review data entry is required (not auto-determined)
Default template value is NO_GO (safety-first default)
Measurement workflow is sequential and has clear halt points
All blocked actions remain in governance
Phase dependencies are accurate and complete

completion_gate.gate_condition: Design structure approved AND design review checklist all confirmed
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 15-8 (receiver validator final measurement report design) can proceed in parallel; Phase 15-9 (completion declaration) waits for both 15-7 and 15-8 approval
